text:
Priya (People Ops): Quick thread — Sofia (current H-1B employee) is requesting a role adjustment from Senior ML Engineer -> Staff ML Engineer and wants us to submit an H-1B amendment. Shes also asking if remote-work from Portugal is OK during transition. Can we confirm next steps?
Arun K (Eng Manager): Thanks. Sofias scope will expand to own cross-team inference orchestration (SR-ops). I support amendment. Need exact job duties and revised title/salary.
Sofia M (candidate): Confirmed new title Staff ML Engineer. New duties: lead cross-team rollout of model sharding, own latency SLOs, mentor two senior ICs, and define runtime contract for partners. Also: planning 3-week remote stint Portugal June 6-26 for family reasons will that block amendment?
Lynn (Immigration Counsel): Amendment typically needed when theres a material change in duties/title. We'll prepare LCA and amended petition. Remote work outside US can complicate H-1B payroll/tax but is OK short-term. Need: updated job description, salary, SOC code, worksite info (if Portugal we'll mark as temporary remote), and confirmation of duties.
Priya (People Ops): Payroll/tax note  tagging Payroll Bot. Payroll, can we pay while Sofia is remote Portugal for 3 weeks? Any compliance flags?
Payroll Bot: Short remote travel under 30 days is allowed; continue US payroll but employee must complete remote-work form and provide local tax residency info if asked. For >30 days or permanent move, need consult with Global Mobility. Provide payroll a copy of passport and travel dates.
Arun K (Eng Manager): Salary bump approved to USD 205,000 base effective on promotion date May 15. Ill send a short manager blurb for the letter.
Priya (People Ops): Sofia, please confirm passport name/number via DM and whether you'll be on US benefits while remote. Also we'll need signed acceptance of title/salary change to attach to amendment packet.
Sofia M (candidate): DM sent with passport. I accept new title and salary, start date May 15. I want to ensure no gap in benefits when I'm remote June 6-26.
Lynn (Immigration Counsel): For amendment timeline expect 2-6 weeks for LCA + USCIS receipt if filing amended petition. If premium processing is needed (15 calendar days) we can request it but cost center approval required. Temporary remote travel to Portugal is fine but add a short clause in employer letter: "employee remains under Redwood payroll and benefits during temporary paid travel abroad."
Priya (People Ops): I'll prepare amendment packet checklist: signed promotion acceptance, updated job description, manager blurb, LCA info (worksite), passport copy, remote-work form, payroll confirmation, and signature page. Target to submit LCA Apr 28. Everyone ack?
Arun K (Eng Manager): Ack  manager blurb will be in Slack DM to Priya in 10m.
Payroll Bot: Ack  payroll confirmed. Please upload passport and travel dates to secure payroll folder.
Sofia M (candidate): Ack  signed acceptance uploaded. Thanks. Quick question: do we need to put Portugal address in the LCA?
Lynn (Immigration Counsel): Not for LCA; LCA covers US worksites. We'll add a separate memo documenting temporary abroad dates for HR records and visa compliance. If remote period extends >30 days we revisit.
Priya (People Ops): Great. I'll draft the employer letter and route to Legal for final wording about holding position and payroll continuity. If we decide to use premium processing, who signs off on the cost? Arun/payroll?
Arun K (Eng Manager): Approve premium processing cost up to $2,500 charge to SR-ops budget.
Priya (People Ops): Noted. Lynn, can Legal turn around the letter in 24 hours?
Lynn (Immigration Counsel): Yes, will review and return by Apr 26 EOD. Recommend including remote clause and the new duty list.
people-ops-bot: Thread archived in #people-ops for audit."
